name: arcade-char_golem-armored-task51
prompt: A towering, monolithic stone golem with a rugged, blocky physique, featuring deep fissures filled with ethereal, pulsing cerulean light. The golem wears heavy, battle-worn steel plate armor over its rocky torso, including ornate riveted pauldrons and an intricately engraved breastplate. A tattered, vivid crimson tabard with worn gold-stitched trim hangs across the chest, partially obscuring the glowing runic cracks beneath. The character stands in a wide, grounded stance with thick, short legs encased in matching steel greaves. High-contrast shading defines the jagged rock textures and metallic surface sheen, with sharp, medium-weight outlines providing structural clarity. The aesthetic emphasizes a gothic, heroic presence with subtle, cool-toned rim lighting highlighting the edges of the stone and metal.
